component.name: Auto USB/IP-QT
component.summary: Automatic USB-over-IP device manager and gamepad diagnostics

description.p: Auto USB/IP-QT is an encrypted, zero-configuration USB-over-IP device management suite. It enables seamless forwarding of USB devices over local networks with automated mDNS server discovery, granular PolicyKit authorization, TLS 1.3 control encryption, and real-time device health telemetry.

ul.li: Zero-configuration mDNS discovery for Linux and Windows USB/IP servers
Passwordless Polkit and systemd ambient capability security model
Integrated Gamepad diagnostics with Kenney vector prompts, deadzone visualizers, IMU telemetry, and DualSense trigger support
Local and LAN-accessible dark-mode Web Dashboard
Live client and remote server journal diagnostics consoles
Sleep and wake automatic connection recovery

screenshot.caption: Diagnostics Console and Live Event Stream

description.p: Major 2.0 release featuring multi-user lockout detection, subnet scanning, WiX MSI installer, and embedded Inter/JetBrains typography.
